column1: # qa/c10-mutations.tsv — the named mutation to apply to each FIXED lint (at GREEN) to prove the new guard bites.

# toolbelt/<lint>.sh, run the pin, observe the flip, restore. Columns (TAB): id  pr  s-item  file  suite  flips  mutation
# PR map (natural order; confirm against the frozen C10 tasks): PR1=S21 PR2=S22 PR3=S23 PR4=S24 PR5=S25 PR6=client-concept PR7=close.

skip the action->do<Action> body mapping (exempt on any action name) -> EW-s22-neg2 (doAckAlarm writes alarmAck not faultReset) flips to clean; EW10 CompPan-rt back to 0
remove the Pattern-B surface token (implements BIAlarmSource / newOffnormalAlarm) from file_has_alarm -> SP-smoke CompPan-rt back to 1 (:294), S23-pos WARNs again
remove the `cd "$rt"` before the java line (:62) -> S24-cwd (structural test from a non-profile cwd) FAILs; regression from the module dir stays green

harvest the covered set OPERATOR-only (the :310/:338 scanner) instead of ALL @NiagaraProperty ∪ @NiagaraAction -> smoke 7 not 5 (intervalExpired/forceDefrost + a SUMMARY prop go stale); WP-stale-action/summary flip
skip the comment-strip before the [concept] scan -> WP-stale-concept-decoy: the <!-- [concept] --> comment exempts the ghostSlot row (STALE lost)
dedupe STALE by name instead of per-row -> WP-stale-perrow: the marked+unmarked same-name pair collapses (0 or 2, not exactly 1)
